Button

Source: R/buttons.R
kit_button.Rd

A shiny::actionButton() with a class set by the button kind:

Usage

kit_button(id, label, kind = "secondary", ..., class = NULL)

Arguments

id

The button's input id.

label

The text on the button.

kind

"primary", "secondary", or "danger".

...

Other arguments passed to shiny::actionButton() (e.g. disabled = TRUE, icon).

class

An extra class.

Value

<button class="btn ...">.

Details

  • "primary": primary button, lime background, large text, card shadow. One per page, plus the "下一步" ("Next step") at the bottom.

  • "secondary": secondary button, white background, thin border, no shadow. For download, select all, example files, move up/down, copy.

  • "danger": danger button, salmon background. For delete, remove, skip this round.

For a regular button (white background, black border, small shadow, e.g. "對，下一步" ("Yes, next step")) use shiny::actionButton() directly. Start the text with a verb and say clearly what pressing it does; if it leaves the page, add "→" after the text.

Examples

kit_button("run", "執行串接", "primary")       # "Run join"
#> <button class="btn btn-default action-button btn-primary" id="run" type="button"><span class="action-label">執行串接</span></button>
kit_button("all", "全選")                     # "Select all"
#> <button class="btn btn-default action-button btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" id="all" type="button"><span class="action-label">全選</span></button>
kit_button("drop", "這一回合不做", "danger")  # "Skip this round"
#> <button class="btn btn-default action-button btn-sm btn-danger" id="drop" type="button"><span class="action-label">這一回合不做</span></button>
